recall.minute: The Transformer (2017) removes recurrence. Inputs are token embeddings plus positional encodings. An encoder layer computes Z₁ = X + MHA(LN(X)) and Z₂ = Z₁ + FFN(LN(Z₁)), with multi-head attention (e.g. 12 heads of 64) and a position-wise FFN that expands to 4d; it has about 12d² parameters. A decoder layer adds causal masking to self-attention and a cross-attention sub-layer over the encoder output, about 16d², and ends with a linear layer and softmax over the vocabulary. Stacks are 6 (original), 12 (BERT-base) or more layers. Encoder-only models (BERT, MLM pretraining) suit classification, NER and extractive QA; decoder-only models (GPT, next-token pretraining) suit generation; encoder–decoder models (T5, BART) suit translation and summarisation. ViT splits a 224×224 image into 196 16×16 patches, adds a [CLS] token and learned positions, and classifies from [CLS]. In practice, load a pretrained model from Hugging Face and fine-tune with learning rate 2e-5–5e-5 for 2–5 epochs, or use LoRA, W + αBA, to train under 1% of the parameters.
